questions.question: A worldwide ﬁnancial messaging network which exchange messages between banks and ﬁnancial institutions is known as ________.
questions.solution:
SWIFT:- Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication.

It provides a network which enables financial institutions in the world to send or receive information about financial transaction in a secure, standardized and reliable environment.

Majority of international bank messages use the SWIFT network.

questions.question: ‘Marketing Support and Services Scheme’ (in the Eleventh Plan) supports artisans related to _________.
questions.solution:
• ‘Marketing Support and Services Scheme’ (in the Eleventh Plan) supports artisans related to **Handicrafts**.
 
• This scheme was implemented in the 11th five-year plan with the aim to provide direct marketing outlets to the craft persons for participation in various marketing events/melas for augmenting their sales.
 
• The scheme has three broad components i.e. Domestic Marketing, International Marketing and Publicity.

questions.question: Himalaya has emerged from which of the geosyncline?
questions.solution:
Himalaya has emerged from Tethys.

The Tethys Ocean was an ocean during Mesozoic Era.

It was located between continents of Gondwana and Laurasia, before the opening of Indian and Atlantic oceans during Cretaceous period.

questions.question: Trans-himalaya rivers are: __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra, Indus, Sutlej**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Trans-Himalayan Rivers:

__
 
• The Trans-Himalayan Rivers originate beyond the Great Himalayas.
 
• These are the Indus(Sindhu), the Satluj and the Brahmaputra rivers. 
 
• The Trans Himalayas Mountain Region, also known as the Tibet Himalayan Region, is located to the north of the Great Himalayas.
 
• Himalayan rivers are those which originate in the Himalayas and flow through the Northern Plains.
 
• The Ganga, the Yamuna and their tributaries are part of the Himalayan Rivers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Bramhaputra River:

 
• The Brahmaputra (meaning the son of Brahma) is 2,900 km in length.
 
• Source: Chemayungdung glacier (Kailas Range).
 
• Its source is very close to the sources of the Indus and Satluj.
 
• It enters India through Arunachal Pradesh and continues its journey through the Assam Valley and Bangladesh, where it is known as Jamuna.
 
• Finally, it flows into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Tributaries:
 
 
• Dibang, Lohit, Siang, Burhi Dihing, Tista, and Dhansari.
 
 

Sutlej River:

 
• It is the longest of the five tributaries of the Indus River.
 
• The Satluj rises from the Manasarovar-Rakas Lakes in western Tibet at a height of 4,570 m within 80 km of the source of the Indus.
 
• It takes a north-westerly course up to the Shipki La on the Tibet-Himachal Pradesh boundary.
 
• After entering the plain at Rupnagar (Ropar), it turns westwards and is joined by the Beas at Harike.
 
• During its onward journey, it receives the collective drainage of the Ravi, Chenab and Jhelum rivers.
 
• It joins the Indus a few kilometres above Mithankot.

Indus/Sindhu River:

 
• It flows in the northwest direction from its source (Glaciers of Kailas Range – Kailash range in Tibet near Lake Manasarovar) till the Nanga Parbhat Range.
 
• Its length is about 2,900 km.
 
• After entering J&K it flows between the Ladakh and the Zaskar Ranges.
 
• It flows through the regions of Ladakh, Baltistan and Gilgit.
 
• The river empties into the Arabian Sea south of Karachi after forming a huge delta.

questions.question: Buddha was born in _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lumbini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Gautam Buddha:

 
 
• He was born as Siddhartha Gautama in circa 563 BCE, in a royal family in Lumbini which is situated near the Indo-Nepal border.
 
• His family belonged to the Sakya clan which ruled from Kapilvastu, Lumbini.
 
• At the age of 29, Gautama left home and rejected his life of riches and embraced a lifestyle of asceticism or extreme self-discipline.
 
• After 49 consecutive days of meditation, Gautam attained Bodhi (enlightenment) under a pipal tree at Bodhgaya, Bihar.
 
• Buddha gave his first sermon in the village of Sarnath, near Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh. This event is known as Dharma Chakra Pravartana (turning of the wheel of law).
 
• He died at the age of 80 in 483 BCE at Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh. The event is known as Mahaparinibban or Mahaparinirvana.
 
• He is believed to be the eighth of the ten incarnations of Lord Vishnu (Dashavatar).

questions.question: What is the ofﬁcial language of Nepal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Himalayan region of South Asia** is home to the** Indo-Aryan language of Nepal.**
 
• It is the most frequently spoken and** official language in Nepal, **where it also functions as a lingua franca.
 
• Both the **Gorkhaland Territorial Administration of West Bengal **and the** Indian state of Sikkim recognize Nepali** as an official language.
 
• **78% of people** in **Nepal speak Nepali **as a first or second language, and it is an official language.
 
• **All 121 of the additional languages **are acknowledged national tongues.
 
• The second most often spoken language is** Maithili.​ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhojpuri:**

 
 
• The** Terai region of Nepal and the Bhojpur-Purvanchal region** of India are home to the Indo-Aryan language known as Bhojpuri.
 
 
 
• **Tharu:**
 
 
• Any Indo-Aryan language spoken by the Tharu people in the Terai region of Nepal and the nearby states of **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar **in India are referred to as a Tharu language.
 
 
 
• **Hindi:**
 
 
• **An Indo-Aryan tongue**, Hindi is mostly spoken in the Hindi Belt.

questions.question: Isotopes of an element have ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Different number of neutrons**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Isotopes**

 
 
• The nuclei have been classified based on the number of protons (**atomic number**) or the total number of nucleons (**mass number**) as follows -
 
 
 
• Isotopes:
 
 
• The atoms of an element having the same atomic number but a different mass number are called isotopes. All isotopes have the same chemical properties.
 
 
 
• Isobars:
 
 
• The nuclei which have the same mass number (A) but a different atomic number (Z) are called isobars.
 
 
 
• Isotones:
 
 
• The nuclei having an equal number of neutrons are called isotones. For them both the atomic number (Z) and mass number (A) are different, but the value of (A – Z) is the same.
 
 

EXPLANATION__:

 
• From above it is clear that the atoms of an element having the same atomic number but a different mass number are called isotopes. Therefore option 3 is correct.
 
• All isotopes have the same chemical properties.

questions.question: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth comes under which category of Fundamental Rights in Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Equality**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution provided for six Fundamental Rights,
 
• Right to equality comprises Articles 14-18 they are, 
 
• Equality before the law and equal protection of laws (Article 14).
 
• Article 15 of the constitution deals with the Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth which is under the right to equality 
 
• Article 16 is about Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.
 
• Article 17 deals with the Abolition of untouchability and the prohibition of its practice.
 
• Article 18 says, Abolition of titles except military and academic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Fundamental Rights are enshrined in Part III of the Constitution from Articles 12 to 35. 
 
• Originally there are seven fundamental rights are in the constitution.
 
• However, the right to property i.e. Article 31 was deleted from the list of Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment Act, of 1978.

questions.question: Which type of epithelial tissue allows transportation of substances through a selective permeable surface in the lining of food vessels or lung alveoli?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Simple squamous epithelium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Simple squamous epithelium:

 
 
• ​It is a single layer of flat-scale-shaped cells.
 
• This tissue makes up the inner lining of the mouth and blood vessels.
 
• It also makes the mesothelial lining of the body cavities.
 
• It allows the transportation of substances through a selective permeable surface in the lining of food vessels or lung alveoli.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5624e9915657362a75a5b4016fe458359e40fb0ef265856efb3ec8773aee89f9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ciliated columnar epithelium tissues are found in the fallopian tube and parts of the respiratory system.
 
• Stratified squamous epithelium tissues are found in the organ system where the body comes into close contact with the outside environment 
 
• Columnar epithelium tissues are found in the stomach and intestines.

questions.question: Bacteria, blue-green algae or cyanobacteria and mycoplasma are examples of organisms of which kingdom?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer is** Monera.**

**MONERA:**

Monera includes bacteria, mycoplasmas, cyanobacteria, blue green algae, actinomycetes.

**PLANTAE:**

Plantae kingdom includes all types of eukaryotic, multicellular, photosynthetic plants.

**ANIMALIA:**

Animalia kingdom includes vertebrates, insects, raptiles, amphibians, etc

**PROTISTA:**

Protista are eukaryotic organisms that cannot be classified as a plant, animal or fungus. Kelp or seaweed is an example of Protista.

questions.question: Find the resistance (in mega Ω) of a wire of length 10 m, cross sectional area 1 cm² and made of a material of resistivity 100 Ωm.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 10**

**CALCULATION:**

R - Resistance

p - Resistivity

l - length

A = area

**We have formula of Resistance:**

R = frac{{rho l}}{A}

A = 1cm² =0.0001m²

R = 100×10/.0001 = 100 ×10 ×10000 = 10⁷

1 mega Ω = 10⁶ Ω

R = 10* 10⁶Ω or 10 mega Ω

**Therefore 10 mega Ω is corrct Answer.**

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, _______ provides options to switch between Normal, Web Layout, Print Layout, Outline and Reading Views.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**View Buttons**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Microsoft Word, View Buttons provide options to switch between Normal, Web Layout, Print Layout, Outline and Reading Views.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The standard toolBar Contains buttons that are shortcuts to some commonly used menu items.

 
 
• The Standard and Formatting toolbars are the two most commonly used toolbars in Office 2003 programs. When you open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint, the Standard and Formatting toolbars are turned on by default.
 
• The Standard toolbar is located just below the menu bar. It contains buttons representing commands such as New, Open, Save, and Print.
 
 
 
• The** Formatting toolbar** is located just below the menu bar. 
 
 
• It contains buttons representing commands such as New, Open, Save, and Print. One can customize the buttons that appear on the formatting toolbar using the customize toolbar menu item. 
 
 
 
• **Tab stop:**
 
 
• **​**In Microsoft Word, tab stop is a position we set for placing and aligning text on a page.
